# Brand guidelines

## Official logo
* **Master file:** `public/brand/modverse-logo-original.png` — the supplied artwork, unmodified (sha256 `ba8167c4…249baac`, 1774×887, verified by `tests/unit/brand.test.ts`). The upload arrived as PNG; the specification's `.jpeg` name refers to the same artwork.
* **Derived variants** (`public/brand/derived/`, regenerated by `npm run brand:derive`): exact crops of the monogram, wordmark, tagline and lockup, plus **luminance-alpha** versions (artwork-on-transparent in the measured letter colour `#F3EFE8`, and a dark ink version for light backgrounds/PDFs). Nothing is redrawn or re-proportioned. Favicon and app icons use the original monogram pixels on the original black.

| Context | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Landing hero, auth pages, Open Graph | Original logo |
| Header ≥ sm | Monogram + wordmark crops |
| Header < sm, editor, admin, loaders | Monogram crop |
| Footer, order confirmation | Light lockup (monogram + wordmark + tagline) |
| Tech pack PDF | Dark lockup on white |

## Palette (from the logo)
`ink #030303` (logo background) · `surface #111112 / #18181a / #212124` · `line #2a2a2e` · `bone #F3EFE8` (logo lettering) · `mute #9b968e` · accent `champagne #c9b896` (restrained metallic). Status colours are muted (`ok #8fbf9f`, `warn #d9b36c`, `bad #d98a7e`).

## Typography
UI: **Inter**. Display: **Cormorant Garamond**. Tracked uppercase labels echo the tagline using **Josefin Sans** with 0.3em letter-spacing. All fonts are self-hosted OFL files.

## Voice
Premium, minimal, precise and honest. Prototype, estimate and simulation labels are part of the brand, not hidden.
